08Construct / RGB Light Rig StudioThree independent lights and an editable product stage.WORKING WEBGL PROTOTYPE+
Original WebGL browser studio · local demonstration

Art-direct the lighting, not just the image.

Construct / RGB Light Rig Studio

A browser-based WebGL study with a neutral beveled object and floor under three dedicated red, green and blue point lights. Select a light, move its X/Y/Z position, adjust intensity and see approximate diffusion, highlight and shadow. Import local stills or video as flat front artwork, reposition the source and render a short loop or proof still.

My role
Creative and interaction direction; prototype production, lighting-control design, procedural material and export workflow.

Launch Construct RGB Studio ↗

Offline HTML · WebGL required · public demo proof, not production software

Simulated shading only—not photographic relighting, calibrated photometry, true scene reconstruction, or After Effects. Browser GPU support is needed. JSON stores controls, not embedded media; actual captures must be inspected before client use.

Recorded demonstration · supplied footage15 seconds. Three lights. One scene.

The uploaded screen recording shows live browser-stage output, not an illustrative placeholder. Source: 960 × 540 VP9 WebM; silent. The downloadable route also includes a compatibility MP4 conversion.
